paras: The ADRO G82 M4 Carbon Fibre Widebody Kit V2 advances our original widebody design with refined aerodynamics and a more aggressive front-end transformation. Built around the V2 front bumper and V2 vented hood, this next-generation package enhances both airflow efficiency and visual presence while maintaining OEM-level fitment.

The kit features widened front and rear fenders engineered to increase track width and stability, a fully redesigned front bumper conversion to optimize airflow management, and an updated carbon fibre hood designed to improve heat extraction. Complementing the widebody are precision-fit side skirts, a rear diffuser, and the AT-R3 dual-element swan neck wing, offering adjustable downforce and improved high-speed balance.
ft: ADRO Widebody Kit V2 for BMW G82 M4
